record.body:
## Description

Status tabs with counts replace the tiles and the d key: Active (default: running, ready, waiting), Running, Ready, Waiting, Needs you (tasks with an open needs-you item), Done, All. Keys 1-7, left/right on the tab row, or a click. The / filter applies on top. Per effort tab, kept across refreshes. Footer, README, and --once updated. Waits on keyboard-focus.

payload.title: Replace the tiles with status tabs that filter tasks

record.subject: status-tabs
